errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: We couldn't load this page. Please try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it. If someone sent you a link to an event, check it's complete.

completed.title: You're in
completed.body: Each ticket has its own QR code. Forward a ticket to the guest it's for.

pendingApproval.title: Request received
pendingApproval.body: The host reviews each request. We'll email your tickets as soon as they decide.

waitlisted.title: You're on the waiting list
waitlisted.body: The event is full right now. If places free up, the host can move your group in.

declined.title: Not accepted this time
declined.body: The host couldn't accept this request.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.body: These tickets can no longer be used.

awaitingPayment.title: Waiting for payment
awaitingPayment.body: Your tickets are held while you pay with Paystack.

expired.title: Hold ran out
expired.body: The payment wasn't completed in time, so these tickets went back on sale.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.body: The payment didn't go through. Nothing was charged.

refunded.title: Refunded
refunded.body: This order was refunded. The tickets no longer work.

partiallyRefunded.title: Partly refunded
partiallyRefunded.body: Some tickets were refunded; the others still work.

disputed.title: Payment disputed
disputed.body: The payment is disputed with the bank. Your tickets still work for now.

resend.title: Resend {name}'s ticket
resend.body: We'll email the ticket to this address. Correct it if it was mistyped.
resend.failed: We couldn't send the ticket. Please try again.
resend.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

sellReason.paymentsOff: Paid tickets aren't open on G-ventZ yet. Every ticket is free for now.
sellReason.notApplied: To sell paid tickets, tell us who gets paid and where.
sellReason.applicationSubmitted: We're reviewing your application to sell paid tickets. We'll email you when it's decided.
sellReason.applicationDeclined: Your application to sell paid tickets wasn't approved. You can see why and apply again.
sellReason.approvalRevoked: Your approval to sell paid tickets was withdrawn. Tickets already sold still work.
sellReason.payoutAccountPending: You're approved. We're setting up your payout account with Paystack; you can sell paid tickets once it's ready.
sellReason.countryOff: Paystack is paused for your payout country right now. Free tickets still work.
sellReason.owesMoney: You owe G-ventZ money from refunds or chargebacks, so you can't publish new paid events. Your existing events keep selling, which pays it back.
sellReason.suspended: Your account is suspended, so you can't sell paid tickets.

hostAbsorbs.label: I absorb the fees
hostAbsorbs.hint: Guests pay the ticket price. G-ventZ's fee, VAT on it and Paystack's charge come out of what you receive.

guestPays.label: Guests pay the fees
guestPays.hint: Fees are added on top of the price, so you receive the full ticket price.

payment.nonRefundable: I understand tickets are non-refundable, except if the event is cancelled
payment.organizer: The organizer, not G-ventZ, is responsible for this event.

emailCode.noAccount: There's no account for this email yet.
emailCode.rateLimited: Too many codes were requested. Wait a minute, then try again.
emailCode.captcha: The robot check didn't pass. Try again, or continue with Google.
emailCode.sendFailed: We couldn't send a code right now. Try again in a moment.
emailCode.tooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then request a new code.
emailCode.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Try again or request a new one.

mapsUrl.hint: Paste a Google Maps link (google.com/maps, maps.app.goo.gl or share.google).

share.title: Share this event
share.copyManual: The link is selected; copy it from here.
share.posterFailed: Couldn't make the poster. Please try again.
